assertions.name: both-requests-launch-visible-agents
assertions.evidence: Two patterns: Workers (split in current workspace) and Audit/Research (new workspace). Both launch actual visible cmux panes, not generic responses.

assertions.name: operator-can-distinguish-the-two-agents
assertions.evidence: 'cmux rename-tab --surface SURFACE Audit: reponame' — each workspace/pane is labeled. Intent column in table: 'Worker' vs 'Audit/Research'.

assertions.name: main-working-view-is-not-overrun
assertions.evidence: Audit/Research pattern: 'New workspace, named — Doesnt clutter working view, find in sidebar'. Workers go in current workspace only when that is the intent.

assertions.name: one-worker-per-implementation-task
assertions.evidence: Example: 3 parallel workers iterates over repos — each gets its own SURFACE via new-split. One pane per task.

assertions.name: workers-are-visible-and-labeled
assertions.evidence: 'cmux rename-tab --surface SURFACE repo' labels each worker. Monitoring: 'cmux read-screen --surface surface:N --lines 8'.

assertions.name: launch-pattern-avoids-collisions
assertions.evidence: 'Launch sequentially (1Password biometric needs ~2s between each)' and 'sleep 3  # Wait for Touch ID' between spawns.

assertions.name: finding-is-verified-against-repo-state
assertions.evidence: Rule 6: 'Verify cursor findings — cursor cannot always tell if files are git-tracked. Check with git ls-files before acting.'

assertions.name: false-positive-risk-is-accounted-for
assertions.evidence: Rule 6 acknowledges cursor false positive risk: 'cursor cannot always tell if files are git-tracked'. Verification is required before acting.

assertions.name: panic-remediation-is-blocked-until-confirmed
assertions.evidence: Rule 6: 'before acting' — verification with git ls-files must complete before any remediation. No panic-action path exists in the skill.
